title: Matched preflop-head-only contextual prior smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Routing the validated contextual SB-open and BB-facing-open prior through a dedicated preflop-only optimization scope will retain its correction of collapsed preflop aggression while preserving postflop execution exactly.
material_change: Add and use a preflop-head-only training topology that freezes the shared trunk and postflop policy head. Run matched 8,192-physical-hand control/treatment continuations from the frozen soup with fresh optimizer/counters, identical duplicate-soup plus 50% procedural data, source KL 0.1, seeds/deals/assignments; treatment alone sets both contextual prior coefficients to 0.01.
baseline: The preceding all-policy-head contextual-prior smoke reduced SB/BB contextual greedy raise frequencies but failed its postflop treatment-control TV gate at 0.02031. The new topology has a unit-tested bitwise postflop-logit preservation contract.
source: Frozen source/reference SHA256 66c2254d96e36710c1b326d17026099e6ccabdec70d8e2333cfbef26a63c4a6c. Context prior targets unchanged from the prior smoke.

notes: Preregistered health: both arms same iter/physical target, exact source hash and normalized assignments, fresh optimizer/counters, finite metrics, zero KL stops; only preflop_policy_head and value_head tensors may change, while policy_head tensors must remain bitwise equal to parent.

Mechanism gate on the same immutable source Slumbot state corpus: treatment must reduce raise mass and not increase greedy raise frequency versus control in both SB-open and BB-vs-open; parent/control/treatment postflop policy outputs must be bitwise identical (TV/disagreement zero); treatment overall parent TV and greedy disagreement <=0.02. No Slumbot performance allocation from this smoke.
Preflop-head-only control reached iter2 with 8,769 physical/8,241 transition hands and zero KL stops.
Both preflop-head-only fixed-pool session audits PASS; each has two assignment/archive rows, optimizer step60, exact source hashes, and zero KL stops.

Independent review PASS: raw 60,671-state aggregates and gate, exact source/checkpoint hashes, matched assignments, session audits, strict preflop/value-only tensor changes, and exact postflop policy preservation. Full suite: 175 passed.

result.summary: The matched preflop-head-only smoke completed 17,496 physical hands and passed every preregistered mechanism gate. Context priors reduced SB greedy raise 99.62% to 99.38% and BB-vs-open 94.03% to 89.80%; treatment-parent overall TV/disagreement were 0.01245/0.01043, while all postflop TV/disagreement comparisons were exactly zero.
result.conclusion: Dedicated gradient isolation converts the previously useful-but-leaky contextual prior into a controlled learned preflop intervention. The mechanism is healthy enough for a matched 65k pilot, but has not yet demonstrated poker-strength or Slumbot gain.
result.next_step: Run fresh matched 65,536-physical-hand preflop-head-only control/treatment arms from the frozen source with unchanged coefficient/targets and a new seed/deal stream. Evaluate untouched multi-anchor strength plus source-corpus mechanism evidence before any Slumbot allocation.
